source_message.text: Thank you for the suggestion; we can add it. Please don’t hesitate to recommend any further changes.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
By battery protection, are you referring to a hard short circuit across the battery terminals? The AXP2101 already provides overcharge protection by cutting off at 4.2V, as well as overdischarge protection with a configurable cutoff of ~3.0V.
As for the NTC, yes, we should add it to J\_BAT.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes, thank you for the excellent suggestions. Everything looks good so far, and I need to revise the document.

routing_warnings.description: The claim concerns AXP2101 exposed-pad thermal handling in the PCB design rather than battery safety protection.
The observed abnormal L3 voltages concern DCDC1 rail regulation rather than battery safety behavior.
The concrete runtime failures concern DCDC1 undervoltage and load-transient collapse rather than battery safety protection.
